##### Project general facts
 
Golf Views Seven City is a unique residential development offering urban living, combining contemporary living with luxurious decor. This exceptional complex comprises three blocks, each with a separate lobby, elevator, and private access to onsite amenities. Featuring studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, Golf Views offers sanctuaries of luxury and comfort for all residents, with modern, minimalist, and spacious apartments complete with all furnishings and appliances.

Residents enjoy the epitome of interactive, social, and active living with community parks, state-of-the-art gym facilities, world-class golf courses, and basketball and tennis courts. The development features ladies' and gents' spa facilities, extensive private terraces, a state-of-the-art gym, an onsite shopping mall, landscaped gardens, fine dining restaurants, multiple children's play areas, exclusive residence pools, and a rooftop lounge. With a treasure trove of five-star facilities from the region's best hotelier, including an array of fine dining and sophisticated lounge areas, Golf Views offers unrivaled service from the comfort of your home.

Every residence at Golf Views is exquisitely designed and impeccably finished, with breathtaking views from each balcony. Apartments feature high-quality furnishings and finishes with floor-to-ceiling windows to maximize natural light and spacious balconies with amazing city or golf course views. One-bedroom apartments include separate air-conditioning controls, flat-screen televisions, guest toilets, en-suite master bedrooms, and walk-in wardrobes. Three-bedroom apartments feature meticulous attention to detail with exquisite features such as floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto large balconies, enhanced by open spaces and natural light that pours into every apartment. Kitchens are fully equipped, and all apartments are fully furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Uniquely positioned at the edge of Jumeirah Lake Towers, this exceptional location offers unparalleled sights across two of the most contrasting areas of Dubai. Whether it is the blue city lights and high-rise Marina towers, or the far-reaching green of the Emirates Golf Course, Golf Views offers an exclusive panorama of it all.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity. Situated just a stone's throw from the city's central highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, and an exceptional transportation network including two metros and accessible walkways, Golf Views is your gateway to Dubai. Dubai Marina, JBR, Dubai International Airport, Media City, and the Emirates Golf Course are all within easy reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies chic living, sporting excellence, and a prime Dubai address, this location delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class golf, vibrant city energy, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can explore a world of sporting activities.
